name: Local hold crop classifier
architecture: 96 ExtraTrees, maximum depth 18, minimum leaf size 2, and 1,152 local image features.
development_split: The first 12 images in each of the four archives form the development set. The internal scene-separated check trains on images 1–8 and evaluates images 9–12. The final model uses all 48 development images. Images 13–20 are excluded from training.
training_reference: CAD object-ID masks rendered from previously recovered scene references. These supply supervised development labels only.
runtime_inputs: Centered 24-pixel and 40-pixel RGB crops: gradient histograms, saturation, and intensity. No global image coordinates, filenames, scene identifiers, generator seeds, or reference JSON enter the classifier.
scope: Training covers the three hold families sampled in the released distribution. Cube holds are absent from these training labels. Geometric fitting retains all four CAD meshes.
validation_scope: The reserved subset was evaluated earlier in the project. It is validation for this tuning round, not a fresh unseen dataset.
